einzeiler: Celebrating Celtic culture with music, community updates, and independent artists.
kurzfassung: This episode of the Irish and Celtic Music Podcast presents a diverse selection of contemporary Celtic tunes and folk songs. Host Mark Gunn shares updates about planning the upcoming Celtic Podfest and reads a heartfelt listener letter regarding immigration detention. The show concludes with acknowledgments of sponsors, supporters, and renewable energy.
stichpunkte: Mark Gunn shares details about organizing the upcoming second Celtic Podfest and arts market.
Musical selections feature artists such as Catlin Finley, Will Woodson, and Boxing Robin.
A listener email recounts the tragic death of a friend detained in ICE custody for nearly a year.
The episode highlights independent folk musicians and encourages listeners to support them directly.
Further musical acts include Robding Nagy and Bards, The McDades, and Irish Millie.
Listeners are invited to vote for their favorite tracks over a three-week period to shape the best-of-the-year episode.
The show closes with credits for sponsors, producers, and patrons supporting the podcast.

clips.hook: Dietary composition during a Scottish trip
clips.text: The host humorously breaks down his current physical makeup while traveling through Scotland.

clips.hook: Tragic outcome after months of detention
clips.text: A listener shares that an acquaintance passed away just weeks before reaching one full year inside immigration detention.

clips.hook: Reflections on the fleeting nature of time
clips.text: Lyrics reflect on how quickly childhood figures age and how fast the years pass by between family members.
A song introduction explores a surprising personal encounter in a hallway that altered the singer's viewpoint.

clips.hook: Economic shifts in modern power generation
clips.text: Renewable sources like solar and wind have become the most affordable energy options in history, lowering household expenses.

Fifteen artists, one hour, and not a dull mile in it. It's the Irish & Celtic Music Podcast #773. - - Subscribe now at CelticMusicPodcast.com!

Troy of The Secret Commonwealth emailed a sad follow up back in March to the news about his friend who was illegally held in ICE custody: "Marc, thank you so much for sharing the fundraiser for my friend on your new episode.
It is with profoundly heavy heart that I have to tell you that my friend died last Sunday of a heart attack. He had been moved to a hospital in Mississippi and apparently suffered two successive attacks. His body is being returned now.
To say we are devastated and infuriated would be inadequate to describe our state of being. We had just been sending his lawyers important records and documents that we felt, along with his obvious serious health conditions, had a very good chance of securing his release. We'll never know now if that would have proven to be true, but we just needed him to endure a little while longer, which he ultimately could not. He died one month short of a year since being detained by ICE.
I have not yet publicly announced this in an update to our fundraiser because, frankly, it's still too fresh and painful to address. But any proceeds we've made will obviously now be put toward the cost of his funeral service.
Sorry to impart this bad news, but I mostly wanted to express my gratitude to you for your kind support on behalf of Pejman's family, my girlfriend (who was his dearest friend in the world and who spearheaded this fight for his freedom) and for me.
Best to you,"
